name: Tomosato Amane
source:
The youngest child in Tomosato househould and Shin'ichi's youngest sister. She was adopted by Shin'ichi's father because her parents died early in an accident. 

[spoiler]In reality, she is an illegitimate child of Shin'ichi's father, which makes her a half-sibling to the Tomosato siblings. Amane's mother had to raise her alone, leading to a difficult and challenging upbringing. Consequently, she harbors a deep-seated desire for revenge and seeks to dismantle the Tomosato family.[/spoiler]
